activities.title: Three States of Matter
activities.skill: Reading a science text to match a description
activities.directions: Read the text. Tap the state that flows and takes the shape of its container.
activities.directionsEs: Lee el texto. Toca el estado que fluye y toma la forma de su recipiente.
activities.prompt: Which state flows and takes the shape of its container?
activities.promptEs: ¿Qué estado fluye y toma la forma de su recipiente?
passage: Everything around us is made of matter. Matter has three common states.
A solid, like an ice cube, keeps its own shape.
A liquid, like water, flows and takes the shape of its container.
A gas, like the air in a balloon, spreads out to fill the space it is in.
vocabulary: materia: todo lo que ocupa espacio
frames: A ___ flows and takes the shape of its container.
activities.correct: A liquid flows and takes the shape of its container, like water in a cup.

distractorFeedback.a: A solid keeps its own shape, like an ice cube.
distractorFeedback.b: A gas spreads out to fill the space.

activities.title: How a Plant Grows
activities.skill: Reading to put events in order
activities.directions: Read the text. Tap the pictures in the order the plant grows.
activities.directionsEs: Lee el texto. Toca los dibujos en el orden en que crece la planta.
passage: Look at a sunflower in summer! Its big yellow flower opens only when the plant is tall and strong.
But every sunflower begins as a tiny seed in the soil.
Before anything grows up, a root pushes down into the dirt.
After the root, a green stem grows up and makes leaves.
vocabulary: the part of a plant that grows down into the soil
raíz: la parte de la planta que crece hacia abajo en la tierra
the part that holds up a plant
tallo: la parte que sostiene la planta
activities.correct: Seed, root, stem with leaves, then the flower. The text tells the flower first, but it opens last.

itemFeedback.s: Find the word begins. It tells how a sunflower starts.
itemFeedback.r: Before anything grows up tells you when the root grows.
itemFeedback.l: The stem grows up after the root pushes down.
itemFeedback.f: The text names the flower first. Read only when again.
